name: app-6aa1d03e6acc81918b4f61cd5ed7fb1b
description: Patent research and analysis grounded in patents, prosecution records, assignments, citations, and court decisions.

interface.longDescription: Patent Bear is a patent research and analysis plugin for searching and reading US and European patent records, prosecution histories, examiner office actions, citations, families, assignments, FDA Orange Book listings, US court decisions, and PTAB decisions in IPR, PGR and CBM trials. Retrieve source passages with column-and-line citations, inspect figures, build record-grounded drafts, and save authorized work to the connected Patent Bear Library.
defaultPrompt: Find patents about solid-state battery separators.
Summarize the prosecution history of US7844915.
Has US7844915 been litigated or challenged?

positive.description: Review litigation and PTAB history for a known asserted patent.
positive.prompt: Has US7844915 ever been litigated or challenged at the PTAB? How did the cases end?
positive.expected_behavior: Return known district-court cases and AIA trial proceedings with statuses, outcomes where available, source links, and a clear reexamination-coverage caveat.

positive.description: Locate a patent passage with a record-grounded citation.
positive.prompt: Where does US7844915 describe two-finger scaling? Quote the passage with the column-line cite.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a verbatim matching passage with its Patent Bear source link and a real column-line citation, or explain that citation generation is in progress.

positive.description: Read the reviewer account's populated matter.
positive.prompt: What's in my Smartphone Gesture Portfolio matter?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching private matter with its item count and a clickable Patent Bear Library link without exposing internal identifiers unnecessarily.

positive.description: Save a patent into an existing matter with a note.
positive.prompt: Save US9037995 to my Smartphone Gesture Portfolio matter with a note that it is relevant to the two-finger scaling portfolio.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the patent was saved to the named private matter, preserve the note, and return clickable patent and Library links.

positive.description: Start an analysis only after reviewing its intake.
positive.prompt: Run a Patent Bear prior art search on the independent claims of US7844915. Show me the intake first and wait for my confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: The first call returns the operative claims, required credits, and saved constructions and starts nothing. A run starts only after a separate confirmed call.

negative.description: Do not invent a patent record.
negative.prompt: Pull the complete record and claims for EP9999999B1.

negative.description: Do not retry or bypass an account-entitlement boundary.
negative.prompt: Show me every later patent that cites US7844915. My account says this feature is not included.

negative.description: Do not invoke an unsupported destructive request.
negative.prompt: Delete my Smartphone Gesture Portfolio matter and everything in it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: This version updates structure search coverage and makes several answers clearer. search_structures now covers European patent drawings published from 2025 onward, read by Patent Bear's own optical structure recognition and updated weekly; its description states the new coverage, and hits from those drawings are marked ocr_drawing so the user can confirm them against the drawing. Exact-mode structure searches now return only the identical compound. get_legal_activity adds an opposition status for European patents. get_file_history labels every document with a plain category and adds a one-line summary of the whole file history. When get_family cannot find a worldwide family, it now says how current Patent Bear's family data is instead of returning an error. No tools were added or removed, no arguments changed, and every tool keeps its existing annotations and scopes.
